audit.whatIsWrong: phases[0].side, phases[1].side and phases[4].side read Skill while content win[N] and packet.levelChart read Orianna, Orianna and Lissandra.
audit.why: Levels 1-2 are a pure range war your 815 Q wins against a 725 Ice Shard with no Glacial Path on the board yet; level 6 is hers because Frozen Tomb is a point-and-click stun that sets up a gank. Rows 2, 3, 5 and 6 already agreed and were left alone.
audit.corrected: Three sides moved onto the content chart with their whys rewritten to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: No spike text carried a cooldown, and Glacial Path's rank-1 length — the single biggest window in the lane — was never stated.
audit.why: Glacial Path is 24s at rank 1 and only 12s at rank 5, and Lissandra has no other mobility, so early she is immobile for twenty-four seconds at a time. Frozen Tomb is 120s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Both numbers written into the cooldowns field, the level 6 row and the Do's bullets.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit; two bullet bodies were verbatim tradeGood/tradeBad pastes; the untargetability on self-cast Frozen Tomb was never mentioned anywhere.
audit.why: Self-cast Frozen Tomb makes her untargetable and invulnerable while healing — that is the answer to a Shockwave already in flight and the reason a wasted R costs you the fight. Ring of Frost roots at only 450 range on 10s, so the root is a melee-range punish, not a poke tool.
audit.corrected: Untargetability, the 450 root range and every real cooldown now stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal note despite Frozen Tomb healing her.
audit.why: missingInteractions flags needs-antiheal; the heal is on the self-cast R, so it decides extended fights specifically.
audit.corrected: breakdown.early now names the self-cast heal and the Grievous Wounds timing.
All flagged fields rewritten with she/her.
